candidate_claims.evidence_basis: ClinVar record VCV000545270.1 (deletion, inner coordinates 21956007-22224188) reports a likely pathogenic classification with Schizophrenia as the trait.

candidate_claims.text: A partially overlapping deletion variant in ClinVar is classified as likely pathogenic for Autism.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: ClinVar record VCV000545271.1 (deletion, inner coordinates 21959229-22218520) reports a likely pathogenic classification with Autism as the trait.

candidate_claims.evidence_basis: dbVar variant nsv7907941 partially overlaps the SV coordinates and is reported as of uncertain significance.

candidate_claims.text: The deletion is predicted by VEP to cause complete transcript ablation of multiple protein-coding genes, including MAPK1, TOP3B, and UBE2L3.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: VEP predicted consequences indicate 100% transcript ablation (HIGH impact) for canonical transcripts of MAPK1, SDF2L1, PPM1F, YDJC, CCDC116, ZNF280A, YPEL1, UBE2L3, TOP3B, and PPIL2 within the deletion coordinates.

candidate_claims.text: Multiple partially overlapping deletion variants are recorded in gnomAD-SV at very low allele frequencies.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: gnomAD-SV database lists several overlapping deletions (e.g. DEL_chr22_393105dd, DEL_chr22_a1666a1d) with low allele frequencies ranging from 8e-06 to 0.000119.

candidate_claims.text: Overlapping copy number losses are observed in healthy control cohorts compiled in the DGV Gold Standard dataset.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: DGV Gold Standard records indicate various copy number losses overlapping parts of the 22q11.2 distal region, with variable sample counts and frequencies.

candidate_claims.text: The genomic region coordinates contain several annotated genes and transcripts, including non-coding RNA genes such as lncRNAs and miRNAs.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: Ensembl nominal gene and transcript records list lncRNAs (e.g., ENSG00000273342) and microRNAs (e.g., MIR301B, MIR130B) within the deletion interval.

candidate_claims.text: Multiple regulatory features, including promoters and enhancers, are annotated within the deleted interval.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: Ensembl regulatory annotations note promoters (e.g., ENSR22_9BK5L) and enhancers (e.g., ENSR22_C45R7) in the region.

candidate_claims.text: Repeat sequences, such as Alu elements and simple repeats, are annotated near both the start and end breakpoints of this genomic region.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: Ensembl repeat annotations identify AluY and other repeats at the start breakpoint and ERV3/AluSx1 repeats at the end breakpoint.

candidate_claims.text: Published clinical literature describes patients with distal 22q11.2 deletions presenting with phenotypes such as congenital heart defects, immunodeficiency, or craniofacial microsomia.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: Scientific literature abstracts report phenotype associations like congenital heart defects (PMID-22318985), central/distal 22q11.2 deletions (PMID-25123976), craniofacial microsomia (PMID-29288792), immunodeficiency (PMID-32256297), and Mexican patient cohorts (PMID-41165438).

candidate_claims.text: Published literature links deletion or loss of TOP3B with cognitive impairment, facial dysmorphism, autism susceptibility, or genome instability.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: Published papers report associations between TOP3B and cognitive impairment/facial dysmorphism (PMID-27880953), autism susceptibility (PMID-32028044), and increased genome instability (PMID-31795919).

candidate_claims.text: Scientific literature outlines functional roles of UBE2L3 in inflammation and its association with copy number variations.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: Abstracts detail UBE2L3 functions in limiting inflammation (PMID-37474493), copy number variations in animals (PMID-37372436), and promoter analysis (PMID-10760570).

candidate_claims.text: The high density of repeat sequences at both breakpoints presents a potential risk of low-accuracy alignment or breakpoint misplacement.
candidate_claims.evidence_basis: QC assessment notes repeat regions at both breakpoints (10 at start, 9 at end), indicating a known risk for alignment and mapping accuracy.

candidate_claims.evidence_basis: dbVar records nsv7844015, nsv7842013, etc., represent sequencing-derived variants of very small sizes overlapping specific genes like MAPK1 and YPEL1.

verified_claims.text: The TOP3B gene has no evidence for haploinsufficiency (score 0) according to ClinGen expert curation.

verified_claims.text: A partially overlapping deletion variant in ClinVar is classified as likely pathogenic for Schizophrenia.

verified_claims.text: A partially overlapping deletion variant in ClinVar is classified as likely pathogenic for Autism.

verified_claims.text: A partially overlapping copy number variation variant in dbVar is classified as of uncertain significance.

verified_claims.text: The deletion is predicted by VEP to cause complete transcript ablation of multiple protein-coding genes, including MAPK1, TOP3B, and UBE2L3.
verified_claims.notes: VEP predicts high impact transcript ablation with 100% overlap for the canonical protein-coding transcripts of MAPK1, TOP3B, UBE2L3, and other genes.

verified_claims.text: Multiple partially overlapping deletion variants are recorded in gnomAD-SV at very low allele frequencies.
verified_claims.notes: Supported by multiple gnomAD-SV records showing overlapping deletions with allele frequencies between 8e-06 and 0.000119.

verified_claims.text: Overlapping copy number losses are observed in healthy control cohorts compiled in the DGV Gold Standard dataset.
verified_claims.notes: Supported by DGV Gold Standard dataset containing various copy number losses overlapping this interval.

verified_claims.text: The genomic region coordinates contain several annotated genes and transcripts, including non-coding RNA genes such as lncRNAs and miRNAs.
verified_claims.notes: Supported by Ensembl annotations specifying lncRNA and miRNA genes and transcripts in the nominal interval.

verified_claims.text: Multiple regulatory features, including promoters and enhancers, are annotated within the deleted interval.
verified_claims.notes: Supported by Ensembl regulatory annotations detailing promoters and enhancers inside the nominal interval.

verified_claims.text: Repeat sequences, such as Alu elements and simple repeats, are annotated near both the start and end breakpoints of this genomic region.
verified_claims.notes: Partially supported. While multiple Alu elements (AluY, AluSx1) and other repeat sequences (ERV3, MLT2C2) are annotated at both breakpoints, no 'simple repeats' are explicitly present in the referenced Ensembl repeat annotations.

verified_claims.text: Published clinical literature describes patients with distal 22q11.2 deletions presenting with phenotypes such as congenital heart defects, immunodeficiency, or craniofacial microsomia.
verified_claims.notes: Supported by the provided PMIDs which map directly to distal deletions and these clinical phenotypes (e.g., PMID-22318985 for congenital heart defects, PMID-32256297 for immunodeficiency, and PMID-29288792 for craniofacial microsomia).; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: Published literature links deletion or loss of TOP3B with cognitive impairment, facial dysmorphism, autism susceptibility, or genome instability.
verified_claims.notes: Supported by the referenced PMIDs associating TOP3B loss with cognitive impairment, facial dysmorphism, autism, and genomic instability.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: Scientific literature outlines functional roles of UBE2L3 in inflammation and its association with copy number variations.
verified_claims.notes: Supported by literature abstracts linking UBE2L3 to IL-1beta/inflammation regulation and copy number variation studies.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: The high density of repeat sequences at both breakpoints presents a potential risk of low-accuracy alignment or breakpoint misplacement.
verified_claims.notes: Directly supported by the artifact risk check QC-BL-003, which flags high repeat counts at both breakpoints as a risk for mapping accuracy.

verified_claims.text: Multiple small sequence-resolved copy number variants in dbVar overlap individual genes like MAPK1 or YPEL1 within this genomic region.
